description: Food hygiene profile for Thai venues in a city, a local authority or a postcode district: the distribution of FHRS ratings 0-5 with mean and counts, or FHIS pass/improvement counts in Scotland, plus how old the inspections are. Use for 'how hygienic are Thai places in X' or 'are these ratings out of date'. Returns counts and dates only - no composite score, and hygiene is not food quality.

local_authority.description: Local authority name, e.g. 'Leeds'. Use instead of city.

outcode.description: Postcode district, the part before the space, e.g. 'LS2'. Use instead of city.

name: get_hygiene_profile
title: Hygiene profile
